title: `teploy releases --app X --host S --json`: the app's releases, newest first (rev 14, token releases-json-v1)

current.description: Release id of the currently-active release; omitted when unknown.

release.description: Release id (container version or static release hash).

deployed_at.description: When the release deployed (record CreatedAt); omitted for pre-record releases.

image.description: Recorded image reference; empty for static rows.

image_digest.description: Recorded image digest (image ID or manifest digest).

config_commit.description: Teploy-home config commit the release deployed.

rollback_available.description: Containers for this version are still present (keep_versions retention) and it is not current; static: the release directory is retained.

reason.description: Why rollback is not available; empty when it is or when current ("current release").
